title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Free-Day Allowances by Product
content:
## Scope

This card lists the free days that each product in the Demurrage and Detention Free Time range allows a container record, clock by clock. Every allowance is a whole number of calendar days.

A product either keeps demurrage and detention on two separate clocks, each with its own allowance, or runs one merged clock per direction. The four separate-clock allowances matter only for a product on separate clocks, and the two merged allowances matter only for a product on a merged clock; the column that a product does not use carries 0.

## Allowances

| Product | Import demurrage: discharge to full gate-out | Import detention: full gate-out to empty return | Export detention: empty pickup to full gate-in | Export demurrage: full gate-in to loading | Merged import: discharge to empty return | Merged export: empty pickup to loading |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 7 | 7 | 8 | 8 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 11 | 11 | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 14 | 14 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 21 | 21 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 |

## Reading the card

- The two extension products add to the tariff allowance on every separate clock: three more days per clock under AHL Free Time Extension 3 and seven more under AHL Free Time Extension 7.
- The merged-clock products grant one allowance for the whole import journey from discharge until the empty is back, and one for the whole export journey from empty pickup until loading.

**Q: An import box on AHL Free Time Extension 7 — how many free days are on each of its clocks?**
Eleven on the demurrage clock and eleven on the detention clock, counted separately; the merged columns do not apply.

**Q: An export box on AHL Combined Free Time 21 — which allowance is used?**
Only the merged export allowance of 21 days, running from empty pickup to loading; the four separate columns show 0 for this product.
